RFC2136_NAMESERVER.title: RFC2136_NAMESERVER
RFC2136_NAMESERVER.description: Network address in the form "host" or "host:port"

RFC2136_POLLING_INTERVAL.title: RFC2136_POLLING_INTERVAL
RFC2136_POLLING_INTERVAL.description: Time between DNS propagation check in seconds (Default: 2)

RFC2136_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.title: RFC2136_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT
RFC2136_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum waiting time for DNS propagation in seconds (Default: 60)

RFC2136_SEQUENCE_INTERVAL.title: RFC2136_SEQUENCE_INTERVAL
RFC2136_SEQUENCE_INTERVAL.description: Time between sequential requests in seconds (Default: 60)

RFC2136_TSIG_ALGORITHM.title: RFC2136_TSIG_ALGORITHM
RFC2136_TSIG_ALGORITHM.description: TSIG algorithm. See [miekg/dns#tsig.go](https://github.com/miekg/dns/blob/master/tsig.go) for supported values. To disable TSIG authentication, leave the `DNSUPDATE_TSIG_KEY` or `DNSUPDATE_TSIG_SECRET` variables unset.

RFC2136_TSIG_FILE.title: RFC2136_TSIG_FILE
RFC2136_TSIG_FILE.description: Path to a key file generated by tsig-keygen

RFC2136_TSIG_GSS_KEYTAB_FILE.title: RFC2136_TSIG_GSS_KEYTAB_FILE
RFC2136_TSIG_GSS_KEYTAB_FILE.description: Path to Kerberos keytab file. The TSIG algorithm must be `gss-tsig.`.

RFC2136_TSIG_GSS_PASSWORD.title: RFC2136_TSIG_GSS_PASSWORD
RFC2136_TSIG_GSS_PASSWORD.description: Kerberos password. The TSIG algorithm must be `gss-tsig.`.

RFC2136_TSIG_GSS_REALM.title: RFC2136_TSIG_GSS_REALM
RFC2136_TSIG_GSS_REALM.description: Kerberos realm. The TSIG algorithm must be `gss-tsig.`.

RFC2136_TSIG_GSS_USERNAME.title: RFC2136_TSIG_GSS_USERNAME
RFC2136_TSIG_GSS_USERNAME.description: Kerberos username. The TSIG algorithm must be `gss-tsig.`.

RFC2136_TSIG_KEY.title: RFC2136_TSIG_KEY
RFC2136_TSIG_KEY.description: Name of the secret key as defined in DNS server configuration. To disable TSIG authentication, leave the `DNSUPDATE_TSIG_KEY` variable unset.

RFC2136_TSIG_SECRET.title: RFC2136_TSIG_SECRET
RFC2136_TSIG_SECRET.description: Secret key payload. To disable TSIG authentication, leave the `DNSUPDATE_TSIG_SECRET` variable unset.

RFC2136_TTL.title: RFC2136_TTL
RFC2136_TTL.description: The TTL of the TXT record used for the DNS challenge in seconds (Default: 120)

RFC2136_ZONES.title: RFC2136_ZONES
RFC2136_ZONES.description: List of potential zones (separated by commas)
